releases.name: v0.1.2 - Dependency Updates and Bun 1.4.4 Alignment
releases.body:
## What's Changed

- Updated `@opencode/plugin` to `2.1.3` with matching internal OpenCode packages. The plugin API is unchanged; this brings the host-side provider `baseURL` override fix and more tolerant agent color handling.
- Updated `@types/bun` and `bun-types` to `1.4.4`.
- Updated `@types/node` to `22.20.5`, staying on the Node 22 line used by CI and declared in `engines.node`.
- Pinned `packageManager` to `bun@1.4.4`.

No plugin source changes were required; catalog, web search, and web fetch behavior is unchanged.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/devararishivian/opencode-omniroute/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2

releases.name: v0.1.0 - OpenCode OmniRoute Plugin
releases.body:
## Highlights

A fast, clean OpenCode V2 plugin for [OmniRoute](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute).

- **Chat Models Only**: Filters out non-chat models (image, video, embedding, rerank, audio) so your model picker stays clean.
- **Smart Tier Folding**: Folds flat effort tiers (e.g. `-low`, `-medium`, `-high`) into base models and exposes them in OpenCode's native variant selector.
- **Provider-First Clean Titles**: Models are named as `Provider - Model Name` with repo prefixes cleanly stripped.
- **Accurate Cost Badging**: Emits `cost: []` for unpriced models to prevent fake `Free` badges, reserving `[Free]` for genuinely free models.
- **Active Connections Only (`usableOnly`)**: Hides unhealthy or unprovisioned upstream connections by default.
- **Built-in REST Web Search & Fetch**: High-performance search and fetch tools directly through OmniRoute REST endpoints (`/v1/search` and `/v1/web/fetch`) with native permission enforcement and automatic fallback.
- **Single Credential**: Uses one API key for inference, search/fetch, and metadata without requiring management tokens.

## Installation

```sh
bun add -d @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin
# or: npm install -D @devvara/oc-omniroute-plugin
```
